message: No detected input validation: There are no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on any incoming data; argparse choices restrict a few string arguments but no data-level validation is performed.

No detected untrusted source handling: The code loads models with torch.load and builds generators from a local MODEL_POOL without any checksum verification, signature checks, or pinned revisions for remote sources.

No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label distributions, checks label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before or during training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation (NoiseDataModule with random latent vectors) contains no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs.

No detected model integrity verification: The load_semantic_extractor function uses torch.load(fpath) without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision; there is no integrity verification before deserializing the model file.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor defense mechanisms such as trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection are present anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanisms are imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are referenced anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolated from training data, signed/hashed evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against manipulation; the same pipeline and data sources are used for both training and evaluation.
No detected input sanitization: No input validation or sanitization is performed on incoming data; inputs like noise latents and model paths are used directly without shape, range, or schema checks.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs (segmentation predictions, IoU values) are used directly without NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or calibrated threshold checks.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a GAN-based image segmentation pipeline, not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
